title: The Awakening
description: A short demo story showcasing subplots, action triggers, and action-only choices.

golden_key.name: Strange Golden Key
golden_key.description: The key has no teeth, just a complex series of grooves carved into strange, iridescent metal.

tome.name: Dusty Tome
tome.description: An old, dusty tome. The writing inside is in an unknown script.

river_coin.name: River Coin
river_coin.description: A tarnished silver coin found in the mud.

radiant_sword.name: Radiant Sword
radiant_sword.description: A magnificent, glowing blade that hums with power.

subplots.name: The Hidden Cellar
subplots.description: A dark forgotten place below the room.

paragraphs.text: You wake up in a dimly lit room. The air is cold, and you can scarcely see your own hands, {{playerName}}.
A heavy wooden door stands to your north. To your right, a small window lets in a sliver of moonlight.
You try to remember how you got here, but your mind is a blank slate. The only thing you are certain of is your training as a {{heroClass}}.

params.message: You bang your fist against the heavy oak. It echoes through the quiet room, but no one answers.
A faint warmth washes over you. Perhaps the gods are listening.

paragraphs.text: The door is made of solid oak, reinforced with iron bands. You rattle the iron handle, but it doesn't budge.
There seems to be no keyhole. How peculiar.

choices.text: Go back to the center of the room
Use the strange golden key on the door

paragraphs.text: You press your face against the soot-stained glass. Outside, the night is pitch black. You can barely make out the silhouettes of gnarled trees, their branches twisting like arthritic fingers into the sky.
Suddenly, you notice a faint glow moving through the trees. It looks like... a floating lantern.

params.message: The light pulses twice — as if acknowledging you.

paragraphs.text: The glow slowly grows brighter and takes the shape of the lantern, held by a cloaked figure.
The figure stops directly beneath your window, looks up, and beckons to you. They point towards a hidden lever beside your window.

choices.text: Ignore the figure and turn back

paragraphs.text: You pat down your clothes. You are wearing a simple tunic, but you feel the weight of your trusty Rusty Longsword hanging at your side.
Deep in your left pocket, your hand brushes against something cold and geometric. A strange golden key.

params.message: You now carry the strange golden key.

paragraphs.text: Holding the strange golden key, you approach the oak door again. Though there's no visible keyhole, bringing the key close causes a holographic lock to materialize on the wood.
You insert the key. The door groans and swings open heavily, revealing a dark stone corridor ahead.
You take your first steps out of the room. The air changes instantly, carrying the scent of damp earth and old magic.
A new adventure awaits you, {{playerName}}.
You descend a rickety wooden ladder into the darkness. The air smells of mold and old wine.
In the corner, you see a small chest glimmering faintly in the dark.
The chest is unlocked! Inside, you find a handful of gold coins and an old, dusty tome.

params.message: You carefully slip the dusty tome into your pack. The writing inside is in an unknown script.

paragraphs.text: You finally step past the heavy doors and outside into the cold, starlit night. The forest is vast, and the grand pines loom menacingly over you.
Following the faint orange light, you arrive at an ancient stone shrine heavily covered by moss. The figure is nowhere to be seen.

choices.text: Ignore it and walk towards the sound of rushing water

paragraphs.text: The shrine is beautifully carved from a single piece of dark stone. At the center is a depression that looks exactly the shape of a tome.

choices.text: Place the dusty tome in the depression
Read the inscription on the side

paragraphs.text: As the tome settles into the stone, a hidden door grinds open, revealing the Inner Sanctum. You step inside, feeling an intense magical pressure.
On a pedestal sits an ancient relic. You recognize it from your teachings as a {{heroClass}}.

params.message: You claim the ancient relic! You feel a surge of power.

choices.text: Leave the sanctum and head to the river

paragraphs.text: You brush the moss aside. The inscription reads: "Only those who seek knowledge in the dirt shall open the way."

choices.text: Ponder the meaning and walk to the river

paragraphs.text: You reach the banks of a wide, dark river. An old wooden ferry is moored here, manned by a silent ferryman.
He holds out a bony hand, expecting payment for the crossing.

choices.text: Show him your holy aura (Blessed Knight)

params.message: The ferryman bows respectfully to a champion of the light.

choices.text: Search the muddy banks for something of value

paragraphs.text: You trudge through the mud along the river. After some digging, your hand strikes a hard, cold object—a tarnished silver coin!

choices.text: Take the coin and return to the ferryman

paragraphs.text: The ferryman accepts your passage. The boat glides silently across the water, the fog thickening around you.

choices.text: Step off the boat on the other side

paragraphs.text: You step onto the far shore and find the ruins of an old campfire. The ashes are cold.
Nearby, half-buried under leaves, is an ornate wooden chest with a golden lock.

choices.text: Sit by the fire pit and rest

paragraphs.text: The golden key slides perfectly into the lock. Inside the old chest lies a magnificent, glowing blade: the Radiant Sword!

choices.text: Equip it and rest by the fire

params.message: You equipped the Radiant Sword! Your attack power is immense.

paragraphs.text: You strike a flint against some dry tinder and coax a small flame from the cold fire pit.
You inspect your weapon and steady your breathing. The night is far from over.
Without warning, a massive Shadow Beast leaps from the treeline! Its claws tear through the foliage as it snarls at you.

choices.text: Strike it down with the Radiant Sword!

params.message: The Radiant Sword hums and instantly vaporizes the shadows!

choices.text: Try to fight it with your Rusty Longsword

params.message: Your rusty blade simply bounces off its thick spectral hide...

choices.text: Slip away — you notice a hooded merchant nearby

paragraphs.text: A cloaked merchant grins at you from behind a rickety stall. "Ah, a weary traveller! I have just the thing."
You currently have {{gold}} gold and {{hp}} / {{maxHp}} HP.

choices.text: Buy a healing potion (5 gold → restore HP to full)

params.message: You hand over 5 gold and drink the potion. HP restored to full!

choices.text: Buy a 'Lucky Mushroom' (3 gold — the merchant seems suspicious)

params.message: You eat the mushroom. It tastes bitter... you feel queasy.

choices.text: Buy an antidote (5 gold — cure the poison)

params.message: You feel the poison leave your body. Much better!

paragraphs.text: The beast dissolves into a cloud of harmless dark smoke. The forest falls quiet once more.
You have survived the night, {{playerName}}. This concludes the Storyworld AI demo!
Your blade fails you. The beast overtakes you in a flurry of shadows.
If only you had found a better weapon to fight the darkness... Restart the demo to try again.
